answer: At dawn, agents selling ocean forecasts for a coastal canyon could bid for jobs with credits minted only by burning tokens. Let one burned token buy one unit of bidding weight, regardless of the number of accounts. Validators check the burn receipt and mark its output spent when credits are claimed, preventing reuse under another key. Splitting credits among aliases adds no weight. Buying 1,000 units costs 1,000 destroyed tokens even if the attacker trades with itself; no fee rebate or signup grant may replenish them.
